nodes.title: Native H3 reference conditioning
widgets_values: Remove the green-masked person and reconstruct the background. Preserve the rest of the video, including its camera motion and frame timing.

widgets_values_named.prompt: Remove the green-masked person and reconstruct the background. Preserve the rest of the video, including its camera motion and frame timing.

nodes.title: 01 · Inputs
widgets_values:
## 01 · Inputs

Upload a 24 fps source with dimensions divisible by 32, and a clean version of SOURCE FRAME ZERO at exactly the same size. The anchor is not a character reference. Source timing and framing must match.

SAM selects the person below. Native threshold, square dilation and green compositing create the guide. Review the mask before generation.

nodes.title: 02 · Models
widgets_values:
## 02 · Models

Use the pinned Ref2VA INT8 model, Qwen encoder and H3 video/audio VAEs. Person Remover V1 uses its own LoRA, 12 steps and the simple scheduler. Do not add the Turbo LoRA.

Text Stage Memory releases inactive models between VAE and Qwen encoding in normal residency mode; high-VRAM mode remains unchanged. Model files and license links are documented with the workflow. ComfyUI must support native Start Loop / End Loop. Qualified core: 79be670e2d9be63e238785af307369d2b9039ed1; frontend 1.53.6.

nodes.title: 03 · Source-aligned windows
widgets_values:
## 03 · Source-aligned windows

Plan Windows owns the exact frame ranges, history and seeds. Native Start Loop / End Loop own iteration. Keep the count-mode connections intact. removal_v1 preserves 18-frame generated history, tail repositioning and incrementing seeds. Review Windows provides durable prefix locks and rerolls.

Raw decoded output is assembled once, without pasted-mask finishing.

nodes.title: 04 · Conditioning
widgets_values:
## 04 · Conditioning

Describe the background to reconstruct while removing the green-masked person. Picture 1 is the clean/generated boundary. The green video remains a native guide. Continuation uses generated video and audio history.

nodes.title: 05 · Review and output
widgets_values:
## 05 · Review and output

Finish Windows checks complete source coverage and removes padding/history from delivery. Native Create Video / Save Video write the MP4. Review identity/background, limbs, occlusions and every continuation boundary.

The app separately saves 16-bit FFV1 continuation masters for explicit segment rerenders. Graph validation is not visual acceptance.
